messages:
Ava: quick pulse check — pancake train at 9am (corner diner) or quiet library bench with thermos at 10? who wants which? :pancakes: :books:
Sam: pancake train for me. need strong coffee.
Priya: library bench please. bringing tea and that small portable speaker (low volume).
Liam: i can do either. leaning pancakes if there are vegan options.
Maya: pancake train — i will order the vegan stack ahead, LMK if anyone wants me to add extras. :raised_hands:
Ava: @Maya omg yes pls! Vegan stack and waffles? :drooling_face:
Priya: also happy to swap — if anyone wants a quieter start come to the library plan and we can migrate to coffee after.
Sam: vote: pancakes 3, library 1, undecided 1 — looks like diner wins.
Ava: ok final call — pancakes it is. meet at 8:50am outside the lobby so we can walk over.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — "Pancake Train Meetup" at 09:00 AM, notification sent to attendees.
Liam: bringing cash and a pack of hot sauce for experimentation.
Priya: i'll bring a tiny jar of cinnamon sugar in case anyone wants to sprinkle.
Maya: on it. also i have a cute maple syrup bottle if we need level-up syrup.
Sam: see y'all tomorrow!
